name: Masoud Pezeshkian
summary: Day 85 (Saturday May 23). **PEZESHKIAN MET PAKISTAN'S COAS FIELD MARSHAL ASIM MUNIR IN TEHRAN MAY 22-23 — MEDIATION TRACK STRUCTURALLY ESCALATED FROM INTERIOR MINISTER NAQVI TO COAS LEVEL. ISPR: 'ENCOURAGING PROGRESS TOWARDS A FINAL UNDERSTANDING.'** Pezeshkian + Ghalibaf + Araghchi + Momeni all met Munir during ~24-hour visit (Al Jazeera May 22-23 primary, ISPR primary, Geo TV, Daily Pakistan, Times of Israel). **Pezeshkian represents the civilian-government procedural-engagement track** of Iran's institutional fanout: civilian (Pezeshkian/Araghchi/Baghaei) procedural via Pakistan + legislative-conservative (Ghalibaf) rhetorical-maximalist ('US not honest partner') + military-IRGC (Tasnim 'Iran preparing for resuming fighting') kinetic-ready + supreme-leader (Mojtaba leak directive) nuclear-foreclosure = COORDINATED MULTI-TRACK POSTURE BY FUNCTION, NOT FACTIONAL SPLIT (Sadjadpour 'two hubris' frame at maximum fanout). **Baghaei publicly framed deal timeline '30 to 60 days' for MOU finalization** (Al Jazeera May 23, IRNA) — first publicly-articulated Iranian-side timeline of cycle. Structurally LONGER than Trump's 'every day better' framing AND Al Arabiya leak's 'within 7 days.' Pezeshkian/Araghchi's procedural engagement creates space for partial deal without conceding sovereign maximalism on nuclear, kinetic, or rhetorical axes. PRIOR (May 19): **Day 78. Pezeshkian 'we will never bow / negotiation does not mean surrender' continues as one of five institutional pillars in Iran's refined multi-track posture (alongside FM Araghchi defer-enrichment, Khamenei-advisor Shamkhani conditional-acceptance on sanctions removal, Artesh-Akraminia 'surprising options', IRGC-drill 'all objectives achieved'). **A11 Mojtaba Khamenei DAY 9 OF STATE-MEDIA SILENCE** — May 13 a portrait of Mojtaba was carried at the national football team's farewell ceremony ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup; a portrait, NOT the Supreme Leader himself. The CNN April 21 framing 'Iran's new supreme leader is nowhere to be seen — that might be helping the regime to survive' continues to hold structurally. The IRGC drill's invocation of late Ali Khamenei rather than supposedly-active Mojtaba remains the institutional tell. **The May 7 Pezeshkian-Mojtaba meeting claim is now Day 9 without state-media corroboration** — meeting status unchanged (CLAIMED, unverifiable). Iranian officials denied receiving Trump's May 16 nuclear ultimatum letter — Pezeshkian-led civilian government on the public-rejection track even as Khamenei-advisor Shamkhani publicly offered conditional acceptance. PRIOR (May 14): Pezeshkian 'we will never bow / negotiation does not mean surrender' continues across IRNA — multi-channel state-media synchronisation pattern. No fresh public statement specific to Pezeshkian today. The IRGC's 'Martyred Commander' / 'Labbayk Ya Khamenei' 5-day exercise (A12) named for the LATE Ali Khamenei rather than Mojtaba reinforces Pezeshkian's structural position: civilian government on negotiating track exists in parallel to IRGC kinetic-preparedness track, with neither institutional voice acting as unified executive. The May 7 Pezeshkian-Mojtaba meeting claim is now Day 7 without state-media corroboration — meeting status unchanged (CLAIMED, unverifiable). PRIOR (May 10): **PEZESHKIAN MAY 8 CLAIM OF 2.5-HOUR FACE-TO-FACE MEETING WITH MOJTABA — STILL NO IRANIAN STATE MEDIA CORROBORATION 48 HOURS LATER (no video/audio/photo). The silence is the new signal — narrative-management gap WIDENING, not narrowing.** Speaking at meeting with trade-union and market representatives broadcast on Iranian state TV, Pezeshkian said May 7-8 that he met Mojtaba 'completely unmediated' for two and a half hours but provided NO date, NO location, NO list of other participants, and NO substantive readout (CONFIRMED that statement was made — Times of Israel, Euronews, Al Jazeera, Pakistani Jang, Shafaqna Pakistan; the underlying MEETING is CLAIMED — single-side, no independent verification, no video/audio/photo, no third-party attestation). Same day Al Jazeera ran 'Pezeshkian seeks to quash divided leadership narrative' framing the claim as direct narrative management against Pezeshkian-vs-IRGC factional-divergence reporting. CNN/KVIA same day carried US intel assessment that Mojtaba is 'out of public view but still shaping strategy.' The Pezeshkian claim and US-intel 'out of public view' line operate against each other in the public information space. **Read as intelligence:** Pezeshkian's claim reads as credibility-borrowing move INSIDE the negotiation as much as a domestic-narrative move; the IRGC-vs-civilian-government factional split is not closed by an unverifiable face-to-face claim, particularly one made the same week IRGC publicly attacked three US destroyers (May 7) and Mokhber-adviser delivered the 'atomic-bomb' Hormuz doctrine. The Stage 2 playbook (named senior officials publicly attesting to private contact with the supreme leader without evidence) replaces the prior Stage 1 (written-only statements via state TV). PRIOR FRAMING (preserved as intelligence-context): Reuters/Fox wire-tier 'IRGC blocks president' framing: Vahidi-IRGC inner circle dominates decision-making; Pezeshkian's Apr 11 'collapse within 3 weeks to 1 month' rial warning was vindicated on Apr 29 (rial 1.8M Apr 29; rial 1,812,000 IRR/USD remittance May 8 confirms continued depreciation). Pezeshkian's Sunday electricity-rationing call holds as the operational acknowledgement that US blockade is biting at consumer-utility level.

top_edges.context: 2026-09-17: +0.5 RHETORIC: conditional talks offer (India Today) negated by SNSC/Rezaei within hours — the civilian–IRGC split made public (intel A7).

recent_signals.headline: **GRANTED A US VISA, INVITED (SORT OF) BY TRUMP, AND TALKED PAST BY EVERY INSTITUTION AT HOME.** State granted visas to Pezeshkian, Araghchi and a 'slimmed-down' six-member delegation (NBC 17 Sep; The Week) with movement confined to UN-transit routes, no luxury purchases, comms-team visas denied. Departs Tehran Tue 22 Sep; addresses the GA Wed 23 Sep (Reuters/Mehr; Tasnim: will 'present Iran's positions on international developments' with focus on the war). Trump (Fox, Sun 20 Sep): 'probably open' to meeting him — no Iranian acknowledgement through any channel (IranWire 21 Sep). In the same five days: Rezaei's seven conditions (SNSC) supersede his 15-Sep conditional offer with a harder list; Ghalibaf 'remain closed'; Zolqadr 'until they remove Trump'; IRGC 'new weapons'. Baghaei: NY 'absolutely no charm'. The Rasaei incompetence motion (15 Sep) has no follow-up — dormant. Analysts: Vaez — UNGA is the 'last best opportunity' to avert Oct/Nov escalation; Vakil — a direct encounter would be 'a big deal', low probability. (NBC; Fox; Tasnim via CNBC; IranWire; Time 21 Sep) — travel CONFIRMED; meeting CLAIMED/unaccepted.

**Offered conditional talks — and was contradicted by his own security council within hours.** To India Today (published 14 Sep): Iran is 'ready to hold talks with the United States, including on its nuclear program,' within the NPT, if Washington lifts sanctions, abandons unilateralism and stops 'negotiating through force'; no immediate direct talks (trust 'badly damaged'); Iran 'would not have joined the NPT if it had intended to develop nuclear weapons' — against the hardline NPT-exit bill. SNSC Secretary Rezaei on Press TV the same day: 'No talks until Iran's conditions are met. Period!' — with no mention of the president. Hardline MP Rasaei proposed declaring him politically incompetent; Ghalibaf and most MPs refused ('coup plot'), citing Mojtaba's unity directive (REPORTED). Read with the NYT (13 Sep): the president neither commands the IRGC's sea policy nor, apparently, the state broadcaster's line. (India Today via Business Today/RFE-RL/INN; Press TV; oprep) — CONFIRMED (statements) / REPORTED (motion).

**BRICS podium + NYT 'blindsided' account.** At the 18th BRICS summit in New Delhi (12–13 Sep) Pezeshkian: 'Our people can't be bullied into submission. Iran won't surrender'; met UAE's Khaled bin Mohamed (highest-level Iran–UAE contact of the war) and, per Outlook/NewsCord (REPORTED), Modi, who urged protection of 'freedom of navigation and commerce'. NYT (13 Sep, REPORTED): he was in Iraq for Ali Khamenei mourning when hardliners attacked ships on 6–7 July; he 'angrily called' Vahidi and called the attacks 'reckless'. Read: the civilian president is the visible face of Iranian diplomacy but demonstrably not the controlling authority over kinetic acts.

**PEZESHKIAN'S CIVILIAN-GOVERNMENT TRACK CONFIRMED AS THE PRIMARY OPERATIONAL CHANNEL — BAGHAEI ENUMERATED IRAN'S COUNTER-PROPOSAL VIA PAKISTAN (asset unfreezing + sanctions lift + port-blockade end + 'stoppage of fighting in all aspects' incl. Lebanon + war-damage compensation). MAY 17 'NEVER BOW' STATEMENT REINFORCED BY IRIB 'RETREAT BASED ON FEAR' ON MAY 19.** Pezeshkian's civilian-government track is the operational counterpart to Pakistan's Naqvi channel; the Baghaei (FM spokesman, civilian-FM track) enumeration was the formal articulation of the demands moving through Pakistan. The cleanest publicly-stated example of the Iranian 'negotiate while reframing the postponement as adversary weakness' pattern: state media hardens the rhetorical frame (IRIB 'retreat'), institutional channels keep procedurally moving the counter-proposal. **Sadjadpour 'two hubris' frame applied to Pezeshkian's institutional position**: the civilian-government can carry the procedural deliverable through Pakistan only because the IRGC-state-media axis is publicly delegitimizing the postponement as US weakness — the two-track posture is what permits the channel to function.

recent_signals.headline: PEZESHKIAN VISIBLY MARGINALIZED: PUBLICLY REBUKED STATE BROADCASTER IRIB FOR PORTRAYING GOVERNMENT AND MILITARY AS 'SEPARATE' (AJ 15 Jul) — THE CIVILIAN TRACK LOST THE ESCALATION ARGUMENT; THE 6-7 JUL SHIP ATTACKS SABOTAGED HIS TRACK'S PLANNED FIRST DIRECT TALKS

Pezeshkian's marginalisation has escalated into an open threat to his person. Ultra-hardliners publicly accuse him and Ghalibaf of plotting a 'coup' against Mojtaba Khamenei; a security-linked religious singer threatened him on the record ('it will be us, the blade and your throat') with no legal consequence; and he was met with chants of 'death to the compromiser' at the funeral. Read alongside the Al Jazeera opinion line 'In Iran, Pezeshkian will be the scapegoat for the failed MoU' (13 Jul), the negotiating faction is being set up to carry the blame for the collapse. This makes him simultaneously less able to deliver a deal and more motivated to seek one. REPORTED.
